problem.forbidden: You may not do this here.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more: read the page again.
problem.conflict: Someone else changed it meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try once more.
problem.invalid: Something typed is not right: check the fields.
problem.stepUp: A fresh code is needed for this.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a minute and try again.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again.
problem.offline: The factory's server did not answer: check the connection and try again.
problem.unavailable: It did not work this time: try again.

held.manage: Changing a supplier's data needs the right to manage parties.
held.archived: An archived supplier is read only: reactivate it first.
held.status: Setting a supplier's status needs the purchasing right to set supplier status.
held.qualify: Qualifying a supplier needs the right to manage qualifications.
held.review: Checking what suppliers send needs the right to review supplier documents.
held.decideChanges: Deciding a supplier's changes needs the right to decide supplier changes.
held.ask: Asking a supplier for something needs the right to send requests to partners.
held.bankPropose: Proposing bank details needs the right to propose them.
held.bankCallBack: Recording the call-back needs the right to call suppliers back.
held.bankVerify: The second check needs the right to check bank details.
held.bankReveal: Seeing the whole IBAN needs the finance right to reveal it.
held.receipts: The receipts need the right to see stock.
held.claims: The claims need the right to see purchasing.
held.files: Opening a file needs the right to read files.
held.noEmail: This contact has no e-mail address: add one first.
held.sources: Importing a price list needs the right to manage approved sources.
held.importRun: Importing needs the rights to run imports and upload files.

status.label: Status with us
status.fromParty: Read from the party's status: no supplier status set yet.

problem.reason: Say why: conditional, on hold and blocked need a reason.

dialog.title: Change the status of {name}
dialog.reasonHint: One line. Needed for conditional, on hold and blocked; it shows on the record and at a held send.
dialog.stops: No new purchase order goes to it from now; drafts are held at their send, sent orders run on.
dialog.prospect: A prospect gets sample orders only.
dialog.reachFailed: Couldn't count what it reaches: the change still works.
dialog.reachStops: {drafts} draft purchase orders held at their send; {open} sent purchase orders run on unchanged.
dialog.reachGoes: {drafts} draft purchase orders can be sent; {open} sent purchase orders run on unchanged.

profile.title: Kinds, origin and closures
profile.hint: What kind of supplier it is, its lead time, where it makes what it sells us and when it is closed.
profile.leadTimeHint: Calendar days from the order to the delivery; its closed days are walked past.
profile.hidesHint: Countries, two letters each, separated by commas
profile.clearsTannery: No longer a tannery: saving clears where its raw hides come from and its tannages.

problem.country: Two letters of the country (ISO), e.g. IT.
problem.hides: Two letters per country, separated by commas.

closures.title: Closures
closures.label: Closures of {name}
closures.noCalendar: No closures calendar: only its days off of the week count.
closures.none: No closure in the next twelve months.
closures.ordered: Ordered today ({date}), it arrives on {arrives} at the earliest: {count} days' lead time.
closures.orderedPast: Ordered today ({date}), it arrives on {arrives} at the earliest: {count} days' lead time, past {closed}.
closures.noLeadTime: No default lead time: set one to see when an order placed today arrives.

noOrder.PROSPECT: Sample orders only until it is approved.
noOrder.CONDITIONAL: It may get new orders, on its conditions.
noOrder.BLOCKED: None: it is blocked as a supplier.

receives.title: What each contact receives
receives.hint: Tick what each contact gets by e-mail. It saves as you tick.
receives.invalid: Not saved: a contact needs an e-mail address and must be active.
receives.conflict: Someone else changed this contact meanwhile: it was read again.
receives.emptyBody: POs cannot be e-mailed until one receives POs. Add a contact on the left.
receives.nobodyPo: Nobody receives purchase orders: POs cannot be e-mailed until a contact receives them.

role.PO: POs go to {who}, by their role (orders): nobody ticked them.
role.CLAIM: Claims go to {who}, by their role: nobody ticked them.
role.REMITTANCE: Remittances go to {who}, by their role (invoices): nobody ticked them.
role.QUALITY: Quality mail goes to {who}, by their role: nobody ticked it.
role.DOCUMENT: Document requests go to {who}, by their role: nobody ticked them.

vault.title: Documents
vault.hint: Certificates and declarations with their expiry, and what each one unlocks at PO send.
vault.noKinds: Its kinds are not set: set them on Overview to know what to ask of it.
vault.materials: What the materials it sells us need
vault.emptyBody: Materials that need one will be held at PO send.

doc.CR_VI_TEST_REPORT: a chromium VI test report (below 3 mg/kg)
doc.LWG_AUDIT: an LWG audit or an ISO 9001 / 14001 certificate
doc.AZO_TEST_REPORT: a test report on azo dyes
doc.EN_1621_CERTIFICATE: the EU type-examination certificate of the protectors (EN 1621)
doc.DECLARATION_OF_CONFORMITY: the EU declaration of conformity of the protectors
doc.DURC: the DURC (regular social contributions, valid 120 days)

need.PPE_CERTIFICATE: A valid certificate of the register

gate.CR_VI_TEST_REPORT_one: POs for {codes} need a valid chromium VI test report to be sent.
gate.CR_VI_TEST_REPORT_other: POs for {codes} need a valid chromium VI test report to be sent.
gate.PPE_CERTIFICATE_one: POs for {codes} need a valid certificate in the register to be sent.
gate.PPE_CERTIFICATE_other: POs for {codes} need a valid certificate in the register to be sent.

review.title: Waiting for our check
review.hint: What the supplier sent through its portal: nothing counts until someone here accepts it.
review.changesHeld_one: {count} change of its company data waits: deciding it needs the right to decide supplier changes.
review.changesHeld_other: {count} changes of its company data wait: deciding them needs the right to decide supplier changes.
review.acceptBody: Accepted, it is shared with the supplier, counts for the rules and starts its expiry reminders.
review.lastDayHint: Leave empty for a document with no end date.
review.replacesHint: The accepted copy becomes the next version of that document.
review.refuseBody: The supplier sees why and is asked to upload it again within 14 days.
review.refuseChangeBody: Nothing changes; the supplier sees why.
review.approveBody: Each change is made on the supplier's record now, as shown.
review.refused: Refused: the supplier is asked again.
review.changeApproved: Approved: the record shows the change.

problem.past: That day has passed: an expired document is not accepted.
problem.reason: Say why in at least {min} characters.

request.body: Each supplier gets a request on its portal's Home to upload what we ask of it; it shows there with the due day.
request.done: Asked: the request is on its portal.
request.already: A request waits on its portal already.

qual.title: Qualification
qual.hint: What it is qualified for now, per kind of work or material, on what evidence and until when.
qual.heldAsk: This supplier cannot be qualified here.
qual.emptyBody: Ask one: it rests on the newest accepted questionnaire and the documents it put in force.

heldMove.decide: Only a qualification waiting for a decision is decided.
heldMove.suspend: Only an approved qualification is suspended.
heldMove.lift: Only a suspended qualification is lifted.
heldMove.withdraw: This qualification cannot be withdrawn now.

qual.askBody: It waits for a decision; with no evidence named it rests on the newest accepted questionnaire of the company.
qual.liftBody: It counts again from now. It was suspended because: {reason}

done.ask: Asked: it waits for a decision.
done.suspend: Suspended: it does not count until lifted.

problem.work: Pick at least one kind of work.
problem.materials: Pick at least one kind of material.
problem.days: The end comes after the start.
problem.noEvidence: A yes needs evidence it rests on: an accepted questionnaire, an accepted document or a visit report. Refuse it, or ask a new one once it has evidence.

quality.receiptsHint: What came in from this supplier and what we accepted.
quality.claimsHint: What we claimed from it afterwards.
quality.scoreLater: The scorecard (on time in full, quality, responsiveness) comes later.

bank.title: Bank account
bank.hint: The IBAN payments use. A change waits for a call-back on a number we had before it and for a second person's check.
bank.emptyBody: Payments to this supplier are held.
bank.ibanHint: As on the bank's letter; spaces are fine. It is checked as you type.
bank.waitingYes: A second approval waits in Home › Approvals (due {date}).
bank.nextCall: Next: someone other than who proposed it calls the supplier on a number we had before the change.
bank.nextCheck: Next: a second person checks it; payments use it only then.

held.oneAtATime: A change waits already: decide that one first.
held.notWaiting: This account does not wait for that step.
held.ownCallBack: You proposed this change: someone else calls the supplier back.
held.ownCheck: You proposed this change: someone else checks it.
held.noNumber: No number on file from before the change: add one on the supplier's contacts.
held.notYou: Not for you on this change.
held.waitingYes: A second approval waits in Home › Approvals.

propose.title: New IBAN
propose.body: The new account waits: payments keep using the account in use until the call-back and the second check.
propose.waits: Payments keep using the account in use until the supplier is called back on a number we had and a second person checks it.
propose.letter: Attach the bank's letter to the account's files once it is proposed.

problem.ibanShape: Two letters of the country, two check digits, then 11 to 30 letters or digits.
problem.ibanLength: An IBAN of {country} has {length} characters; this one has {typed}.
problem.ibanDigits: The check digits do not match: a character is mistyped.
problem.bic: A BIC has 8 or 11 letters and digits.
problem.own: You proposed this change: someone else must do this step.

callBackDialog.title: Call-back for {iban}
callBackDialog.body: Call the supplier on a number we had before the change and confirm the new account with them.
callBackDialog.dialledHint: As you dialled it: its digits must be the record's.
callBackDialog.phoneDiffers: The digits differ from the number on file.

hold.ADDED_AFTER: Added after the change was proposed: it may have come with the change.
hold.CHANGED_AFTER: Changed after the change was proposed: it may have come with the change.

verifyDialog.title: Second check of {iban}
verifyDialog.body: You confirm the call-back and the new account: payments use it from now and the account in use retires.
verifyDialog.rule: If an approval rule is switched on, the change waits for that yes instead.

refuseDialog.title: Refuse the change to {iban}
refuseDialog.body: Payments keep using the account in use; the supplier sees it refused.

retireDialog.title: Retire {iban}
retireDialog.body: Payments in this currency are held until another account is in use.

revealDialog.title: The whole IBAN of {iban}
revealDialog.body: Seeing it asks a fresh code and is recorded with your name.
revealDialog.recorded: Recorded with your name. It is not kept on this page once closed.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.propose: The code lets you propose new bank details for 5 minutes.
stepUp.verify: The code lets you check bank details for 5 minutes.
stepUp.reveal: The code lets you see the whole IBAN for 5 minutes.

done.proposed: Proposed: it waits for the call-back.
done.calledBack: Call-back recorded: it waits for the second check.
done.verified: Checked: payments use the new account now.
done.waitsYes: Checked: it waits for the approval in Home › Approvals.
done.refused: Refused: payments keep using the account in use.
done.retired: Retired: payments in that currency are held.

sentence.default: The code lets you go on for 5 minutes.

problem.wrong: That code is not right: type the newest one.
problem.locked: Too many wrong codes: wait a few minutes.
problem.noAuthenticator: Set up your authenticator in My profile first.
problem.tooMany: Too many tries: wait a minute.
problem.failed: The code could not be checked: try again.

tile.expiringHint: Suppliers with a document that runs out soon

expiring.title: Suppliers with documents expiring in 30 days
expiring.intro: Ask them for the new ones before a PO send is held.
expiring.empty: No document expires in the next 30 days
expiring.emptyBody: The tile counts them as their days come.

portalBank.title: Bank details
portalBank.hint: Changed only with our call-back and a second check.
portalBank.none: No bank account with us yet: add one with Change bank details.
portalBank.waitingWords: Waiting: we call you on your registered number before any payment uses the new account. Payments go to the old account until then.

held.preview: This is a preview of the portal: nothing can be changed here.
held.admin: Only your admin changes the bank details.
held.waiting: A change waits for our check already.
held.offline: You are offline: try again when the connection is back.

portalBank.formBody: Type the new account as on your bank's letter.
portalBank.ibanHint: Spaces are fine. It is checked as you type.
portalBank.letter: Keep your bank's letter at hand: we ask for it when we call you.
portalBank.sent: Sent for our check: we call you on your registered number before any payment uses it.

problem.ibanShape: Two letters of the country, two check digits, then 11 to 30 letters or digits.
problem.ibanLength: An IBAN of {country} has {length} characters; this one has {typed}.
problem.ibanDigits: The check digits do not match: a character is mistyped.
problem.bic: A BIC has 8 or 11 letters and digits.

failed.clash: A change of these details waits already, or it is the account in use.
failed.invalid: Something typed is not right: check the IBAN.
failed.forbidden: Only your admin changes the bank details.
failed.wait: Too many tries: wait a minute.
failed.network: It was not sent: check the connection and try again.
